Your father called it nonsense. Your mother started crying. You weren't going to sit in this tower waiting to find out if the psychic was right.

You think of the psychic's warning. Maybe she wasn't being dramatic after all.

2.3.description: You wander down a damp stone corridor, step over murky water, and hear clanking from an open jail cell. Someone's scratched a warning into the stone: THE KING WAS TOLD. best_ending.title: The Best Ending: Complete Victory
best_ending._comment: You successfully breach the fourth wall, confront Abby, Della, Jia, and Tori, and blackmail them into fully completing the code. The game is saved, fully rendered, and celebrated across the kingdom as a masterpiece!

half_agreement.title: Half Agreement: The Compromise
half_agreement._comment: You convince the developers to leave a portion of the world incomplete, saving your unique glitchy realm from total deletion while remaining frozen in a charmingly unfinished state forever.

drucker_saved.title: Dr. Drucker Saved: The Archives
drucker_saved._comment: You manage to escape the main build entirely, getting safely archived away in the deep digital depths of Dr. Drucker's desk, never to see the light of a grading rubric again.

time_warp.title: The Time Warp: Back to the Beginning
time_warp._comment: With the developers' wipe command closing in, the heroes trigger the Time Warp. The kingdom shudders, the screen flashes, and every character is sent back to the start of their adventure. The princess returns to her tower, the paladin to his courtyard, the dragon to its gold, and the jester to his opening act. None of them knows how many times they've done this before. The world survives for now, trapped in a ridiculous, endlessly repeating reset.
